# Lucy Stephenson

Lucy Stephenson is the current Deputy of [District 1](https://flow.je/elections/district-1) and was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2022.

Lucy Stephenson has participated in 1 election since 2002:

- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/lucy-stephenson#e48)

  Elected as Deputy of District 1 with 60.5% of the ballot.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/lucy-stephenson/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k1plAMywIsE)
  - [2022 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20220514152252/https://www.stephenson.je/manifesto)
  - [2022 SCOOP Food Security Questionnaire](https://drive.google.com/uc?export=view&id=1kI5ESEJ4byHHwSp76kLGeBkayQSQynP9#page=15)

Lucy Stephenson has declared her intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Deputies Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [District 1](https://flow.je/elections/district-1). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/03/17/deputy-seeks-second-term-representing-three-parish-district/)\]
